# Finite real-model acceptance relay

Status: accepted for isolated P8 acceptance, not a product provider feature.

A polling budget cannot stop concurrent or internal retry requests before the
network. P8 therefore uses one synchronous admission point in a driver-owned
loopback relay, with durable reservations before forwarding and a total cap of
16. Real credentials stay in that process; the actual product receives only a
synthetic local credential. Endpoint, model, path, method and stream shape are
fixed. Model rejection is a failed result, not permission to substitute a model.

The Main helper exposes four finite operations and binds each reconstructed case
to its own selected ready world/session. Actual chat and tools remain unchanged.
Separate offline tests prove admission and input boundaries. They cannot replace
the subsequent same-source compiled-client, real-model, candidate and gameplay
evidence. Existing fixed sword/town actions do not prove a newly authored hammer
or dog's behavior.
